more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Potassium chloride is used as an enzyme in food. Its technological role is to catalyse reactions during food processing.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern from reported food uses in 2019.
Higher chloride intake can affect blood pressure; some high-consumption estimates exceeded the assessment reference value.
